verdict.rationale: Choosing a data storage region is a fair question for a SaaS project-management product like Linear, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions data residency, regions, or storage-location choices. The items cover the changelog, customer requests, the GraphQL API, agents and the MCP server, none of which address where data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
